title: HAO data part envelope
description: Every file under data/parts/ calls HAO_DATA.register() with exactly this object. Validate the argument against this schema, and its payload against the part schema named in `schema`.

part.description: Unique part id, used in diagnostics. Conventionally the file name without .js.

root.description: Which assembled document this part contributes to.

mount.description: Dot path within the root document, e.g. 'scenarios' or 'gatmoc.kpas'. Missing intermediate objects are created.

schema.description: Path to the schema governing `payload`. Documentation for humans and for the validator; not fetched at runtime.

payload.description: Array payloads mounted at the same path are concatenated in load order; object payloads are shallow-merged.
